"""Billing report adapter for customer-facing invoice messages."""

from formatter import format_customer, format_total


def render_invoice(invoice):
    """Render the plain-text billing summary used by the email adapter."""
    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
        raise ValueError("invoice must be an object")
    customer = format_customer(invoice["customer"])
    total = format_total(invoice["total_cents"])
    invoice_id = invoice["id"]
    return f"Invoice {invoice_id}\nCustomer: {customer}\nTotal: {total}\n"


def email_subject(invoice):
    return f"Invoice {invoice['id']} for {format_customer(invoice['customer'])}"


def render_batch(invoices):
    return [render_invoice(invoice) for invoice in invoices]
